answer: Cross-chain identity binding: stake one ferrous-anchored bond on chain A, reference it from chain B; a sybil must fund and lock collateral on every chain it claims. The check: independent relays verify the same bond address across chains, so identities can't wander between ledgers unlinked. Attack cost scales with chain count — N chains need N locked bonds. This haven of shared collateral makes farming economically irrational.
